name: @aquawisp/desktop
description: 沧渡 AquaWisp 本地优先知识库智能体桌面端
author: AquaWisp Contributors

scripts.package:dir: npm run build --workspace @aquawisp/desktop && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --dir --publish never
scripts.package:win: npm run build --workspace @aquawisp/desktop && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --win nsis --publish never
scripts.package:mac: npm run build --workspace @aquawisp/desktop && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --mac dmg --publish never
